About these terms

These terms govern your use of this website. The website is run by the company that provides the Tribyou services; its registered name, registered office, VAT number, company registration and contact details are given in the Contact section at the end of this page.

By using the website, you accept these terms. If you do not accept them, please do not use it. Our services to client companies, candidates and programme participants are governed by their own contracts, which prevail over these terms for those services. How we handle personal data is explained in our privacy policy, which you can open from the footer of every page.

Sentences marked Placeholder stand for points that are still being confirmed. They will be replaced before these terms are final.

Using the website

You can browse the website, read its content and use its forms free of charge. When you do, you agree:

  • to use the website lawfully and only for its intended purpose: learning about our services, finding jobs and getting in touch with us;
  • to give true and accurate information in our forms, and to send only your own data, or data you are entitled to share;
  • not to upload files containing malware, or content that is unlawful, offensive or infringes the rights of others;
  • not to interfere with the website or its security, overload it, or try to access parts of it that are not public;
  • not to copy the job ads or other content in bulk by automated means, such as scrapers, except search engines indexing the website.

We may suspend access to the website, or reject submissions, that break these rules.

Intellectual property

The content of this website, including its texts, graphics, design, logo and the Tribyou brand, belongs to us or to those who have licensed it to us, and is protected by copyright and trademark law. Other companies’ names and logos belong to their owners.

You may view the content, print or save single pages for your own non-commercial use, and share links to any page, including job ads. Any other use, such as reproducing, modifying or distributing the content, requires our prior written permission.

Job ads

Our job ads describe roles we are recruiting for on behalf of client companies. Each ad is written in the language of the role and is listed in every language version of the website.

We take care to keep the ads accurate and up to date, but they are based on information from our clients, and roles can change, be filled or be withdrawn at any time, including before the closing date shown. An ad is an invitation to apply, not an offer of employment or of a contract, and any pay or contract details it gives are indicative until the hiring company confirms them in writing.

Our job ads are open to everyone, whatever their gender, age, origin, beliefs, disability or any other personal characteristic, and we select only on the requirements of the role.

No employment relationship

Using the website, sending us your CV or applying for a job does not create an employment relationship, or any other contract, between you and us or any of our clients. Whether to hire someone is the hiring company’s decision, and any employment or engagement is agreed in a separate contract between you and that company.

We do not charge candidates or students for our services.

Project-based professionals

Through our temporary staffing service, we introduce interim engineers and specialists who work on a project basis as independent professionals, under project or consulting agreements. They are not our employees. Placeholder: whether these agreements are made with the client company or with us is still to be confirmed. The terms of each engagement, including fees, duration and deliverables, are set in its own contract, not in these terms.

Accuracy of the content

The content of this website is general information about our services and the technical labour market. It is not professional, legal or career advice for your particular situation. We keep it accurate and up to date, but it may contain errors or become out of date; please tell us if you find a mistake and we will correct it.

We may change, update or remove any part of the website at any time. We aim to keep it available, but we do not guarantee that it will always be available or free of interruptions.

Links to other websites

The website may link to other websites, such as the authorities named in our legal texts. We have no control over them and are not responsible for their content or for how they handle your data.

Liability

We are liable in accordance with the law. Nothing in these terms excludes or limits our liability for wilful misconduct or gross negligence, for death or personal injury, or any right you have as a consumer that the law does not allow to be excluded or limited.

Within those limits, because the website is provided free of charge, we are not liable for:

  • losses caused by the website being unavailable or interrupted, or by errors in its content that we did not know about;
  • the content of other websites we link to;
  • hiring decisions, which are taken by the companies that hire;
  • losses that were not a foreseeable consequence of our breach of these terms.

Changes to these terms

We may change these terms, for example when our services or the law change. The date at the top of the page shows when they last changed. The terms in force when you use the website apply to that use; changes never apply to contracts already agreed.
